# Attribute groups

<!-- DO NOT EDIT - AUTOGENERATED FILE. Regenerate with `make generate-all` -->

Attribute group ids are part of this registry's public API surface: consumers
reference them by id, so renaming one is a breaking change.

## `device`

**Stability:** development

The device on which the process represented by this resource is running.

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `device.id` | `string` | A unique identifier representing the device |
| `device.manufacturer` | `string` | The name of the device manufacturer |
| `device.model.identifier` | `string` | The model identifier for the device |
| `device.model.name` | `string` | The marketing name for the device model |
